local function getAreas()
    local seen = {}
    local searchContainers = {workspace}
    if workspace:FindFirstChild('RunArea') then
        table.insert(searchContainers, workspace.RunArea)
    end
    for _, container in ipairs(searchContainers) do
        for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
            local num = child.Name:match('^RunAreaChunk_(%d+)')
            if num then
                seen[tonumber(num)] = true
            end
        end
    end

    local nums = {}
    for n in pairs(seen) do
        table.insert(nums, n)
    end
    table.sort(nums)

    local areas = {'All'}
    if #nums > 0 then
        for _, n in ipairs(nums) do
            table.insert(areas, 'Area ' .. n)
        end
    else
        for i = 1, 15 do
            table.insert(areas, 'Area ' .. i)
        end
    end
    return areas
end

local function normalizeSelection(v)
    local selected = {}

    local function addValue(x)
        if type(x) == 'string' then
            selected[x] = true
            return
        end

        if type(x) == 'number' then
            if x == -1 then
                selected['All'] = true
            else
                selected['Area ' .. tostring(x)] = true
            end
            return
        end

        if type(x) == 'table' then
            if x.Value ~= nil then
                addValue(x.Value)
            end
            for _, item in ipairs(x) do
                addValue(item)
            end
            for key, enabled in pairs(x) do
                if type(key) == 'string' and enabled then
                    addValue(key)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    addValue(v)

    local hasNonAll = false
    for name, enabled in pairs(selected) do
        if enabled and name ~= 'All' then
            hasNonAll = true
            break
        end
    end
    if hasNonAll then
        selected['All'] = nil
    end

    if next(selected) == nil then
        selected['All'] = true
    end

    return selected
end

local function getSelectedAreasLive()
    local optionObj = Options and Options.CYA_AreaSelect
    if optionObj then
        local liveValue = nil
        pcall(function()
            liveValue = optionObj.Value
        end)
        if liveValue == nil then
            pcall(function()
                if optionObj.GetValue then
                    liveValue = optionObj:GetValue()
                end
            end)
        end
        if liveValue ~= nil then
            getgenv().SelectedAreas = normalizeSelection(liveValue)
            return getgenv().SelectedAreas
        end
    end

    getgenv().SelectedAreas = normalizeSelection(getgenv().SelectedAreas)
    return getgenv().SelectedAreas
end

local function isAllSelected(selected)
    for name, enabled in pairs(selected or {}) do
        if enabled and name ~= 'All' then
            return false
        end
    end
    return true
end

local function getNpcAreaNumber(npcName)
    local npcAreaStr = tostring(npcName):match('^run_%d+_(%d+)_%d+$')
    if not npcAreaStr then
        npcAreaStr = tostring(npcName):match('_(%d+)_%d+$')
    end
    return tonumber(npcAreaStr)
end

local function matchesArea(npcName, selectedAreas)
    local selected = normalizeSelection(selectedAreas)
    if isAllSelected(selected) or selected['All'] then
        return true
    end

    local npcAreaNumber = getNpcAreaNumber(npcName)
    if not npcAreaNumber then
        return false
    end

    for areaName, enabled in pairs(selected) do
        if enabled and areaName ~= 'All' then
            local areaNum = tonumber(tostring(areaName):match('%d+'))
            if areaNum and npcAreaNumber == areaNum then
                return true
            end
        end
    end

    return false
end

local function extractUserIdFromFolderName(folderName)
    return tostring(folderName or ''):match('^Player_(%d+)$')
end

local function getAllCloneCandidates()
    local out = {}
    local npcsRoot = workspace:FindFirstChild('NPCs')
    if not npcsRoot then
        return out
    end

    for _, ownerFolder in ipairs(npcsRoot:GetChildren()) do
        local ownerUserId = extractUserIdFromFolderName(ownerFolder.Name)
        if ownerUserId then
            for _, unit in ipairs(ownerFolder:GetChildren()) do
                if unit and unit.Name then
                    table.insert(out, {
                        ownerUserId = ownerUserId,
                        targetName = unit.Name
                    })
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return out
end

local function getCloneAttackTarget()
    local candidates = getAllCloneCandidates()
    if #candidates == 0 then
        getgenv().LockedCloneOwnerUserId = nil
        getgenv().LockedCloneTargetName = nil
        return nil, nil
    end

    local mode = getgenv().CloneSoldierMode or 'Random'
    if mode == 'Single Focus' then
        local lockedOwner = getgenv().LockedCloneOwnerUserId
        local lockedTarget = getgenv().LockedCloneTargetName
        if lockedOwner and lockedTarget then
            for _, c in ipairs(candidates) do
                if c.ownerUserId == lockedOwner and c.targetName == lockedTarget then
                    return c.targetName, c.ownerUserId
                end
            end
        end

        local pick = candidates[1]
        getgenv().LockedCloneOwnerUserId = pick.ownerUserId
        getgenv().LockedCloneTargetName = pick.targetName
        return pick.targetName, pick.ownerUserId
    end

    local pick = candidates[math.random(1, #candidates)]
    return pick.targetName, pick.ownerUserId
end

local function getPrimarySelectedAreaNumber(selectedAreas)
    local selected = normalizeSelection(selectedAreas)
    if selected['All'] then
        return nil
    end
    for areaName, enabled in pairs(selected) do
        if enabled and areaName ~= 'All' then
            local areaNum = tonumber(tostring(areaName):match('%d+'))
            if areaNum then
                return areaNum
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function getAreaWaitCFrame(selectedAreas)
    local areaNum = getPrimarySelectedAreaNumber(selectedAreas)
    if not areaNum then
        return nil
    end

    local targets = {workspace}
    local runArea = workspace:FindFirstChild('RunArea')
    if runArea then
        table.insert(targets, runArea)
    end

    local chunkName = 'RunAreaChunk_' .. tostring(areaNum)
    for _, container in ipairs(targets) do
        local chunk = container:FindFirstChild(chunkName)
        if chunk then
            if chunk:IsA('BasePart') then
                return chunk.CFrame
            end
            if chunk:IsA('Model') then
                return chunk:GetPivot()
            end
            local part = chunk:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('BasePart', true)
            if part then
                return part.CFrame
            end
        end
    end

    return nil
end
local function getPastPointCFrame()
    local runArea = workspace:FindFirstChild('RunArea')
    local persistent = runArea and runArea:FindFirstChild('PastPoint_Persistent')
    local pastPoint = persistent and persistent:FindFirstChild('PastPoint')
    if not pastPoint then
        return nil
    end

    if pastPoint:IsA('BasePart') then
        return pastPoint.CFrame
    end
    if pastPoint:IsA('Model') then
        return pastPoint:GetPivot()
    end

    local part = pastPoint:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('BasePart', true)
    return part and part.CFrame or nil
end

local function hasMatchingNpcInSelectedArea(selectedAreas)
    local runArea = workspace:FindFirstChild('RunArea')
    local npcsFolder = runArea and runArea:FindFirstChild('RunAreaNPCs')
    if not npcsFolder then
        return false
    end

    for _, npc in ipairs(npcsFolder:GetChildren()) do
        local npcName = npc and npc.Name
        if npcName and matchesArea(npcName, selectedAreas) then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function tryAttackInSelectedArea(selectedAreas, pos)
    local runArea = workspace:FindFirstChild('RunArea')
    local npcsFolder = runArea and runArea:FindFirstChild('RunAreaNPCs')
    if not npcsFolder then
        return false
    end

    local combatEvents = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage'):FindFirstChild('shared/network/CombatNetwork@GlobalCombatEvents')
    local attackRemote = combatEvents and combatEvents:FindFirstChild('Attack')
    local cloneAttackRemote = combatEvents and combatEvents:FindFirstChild('CloneAttack')
    if not attackRemote then
        return false
    end

    for _, npc in ipairs(npcsFolder:GetChildren()) do
        local npcName = npc and npc.Name
        if npcName and matchesArea(npcName, selectedAreas) then
            pcall(function()
                attackRemote:FireServer(1, npcName, pos)
            end)

            if cloneAttackRemote then
                local cloneTargetName, ownerUserId = getCloneAttackTarget()
                if cloneTargetName and ownerUserId then
                    pcall(function()
                        local runTag = 'run_' .. ownerUserId .. '_1_0'
                        cloneAttackRemote:FireServer(cloneTargetName, runTag, 0, pos)
                    end)
                end
            end
            return true
        end
    end

    return false
end

local function isRobuxGuiVisible()
    local lp = game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer
    local playerGui = lp and lp:FindFirstChild('PlayerGui')
    local runUI = playerGui and playerGui:FindFirstChild('RunUI')
    local robux = runUI and runUI:FindFirstChild('Robux')
    return robux and robux:IsA('GuiObject') and robux.Visible == true
end

local function doNoTargetFallback(root, selectedAreas)
    if not root then
        return
    end

    local original = root.CFrame
    local waitCFrame = getAreaWaitCFrame(selectedAreas)
    if not waitCFrame then
        waitCFrame = getPastPointCFrame()
    end
    if not waitCFrame then
        return
    end

    local keepCurrentPosition = false

    root.CFrame = waitCFrame * CFrame.new(0, 10, 0)
    while getgenv().AutoAttack and not isRobuxGuiVisible() do
        local pos = root and root.Position or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        if tryAttackInSelectedArea(selectedAreas, pos) then
            keepCurrentPosition = true
            break
        end
        task.wait(math.max(getgenv().AttackDelay or 0.1, 0.1))
    end

    if not getgenv().AutoAttack then
        if root.Parent then
            root.CFrame = original
        end
        return
    end

    if not keepCurrentPosition and root.Parent then
        root.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 20, 0)
        root.Anchored = true

        while getgenv().AutoAttack and isRobuxGuiVisible() do
            local pos = root and root.Position or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            if tryAttackInSelectedArea(selectedAreas, pos) then
                keepCurrentPosition = true
                break
            end
            task.wait(math.max(getgenv().AttackDelay or 0.1, 0.1))
        end
    end

    if root.Parent then
        if keepCurrentPosition then
            -- Keep elevated+anchored while attacking in fallback mode.
            root.Anchored = true
        else
            root.Anchored = false
            root.CFrame = original
        end
    end
end

local function refreshNPCAttackRemote()
    local rs = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
    local events = rs and rs:FindFirstChild('shared/network/RunAreaNPCNetwork@GlobalRunAreaNPCEvents')
    getgenv().CYA_NPCAttackRemote = events and events:FindFirstChild('NPCAttack') or nil
end

local function ensureAntiAttackHook()
    if getgenv().CYA_AntiAttackHooked then
        return
    end

    local okMt, mt = pcall(getrawmetatable, game)
    if not okMt or not mt or type(mt.__namecall) ~= 'function' then
        return
    end

    local oldNamecall = mt.__namecall
    pcall(setreadonly, mt, false)

    mt.__namecall = newcclosure(function(self, ...)
        local method = getnamecallmethod and getnamecallmethod() or nil
        if method == 'FireServer' and getgenv().CYA_AntiAttack then
            local remote = getgenv().CYA_NPCAttackRemote
            if remote and self == remote then
                return nil
            end
        end
        return oldNamecall(self, ...)
    end)

    pcall(setreadonly, mt, true)
    getgenv().CYA_AntiAttackHooked = true
end

getgenv().SelectedAreas = {['All'] = true}
getgenv().SetSelectedAreas = function(v)
    getgenv().SelectedAreas = normalizeSelection(v)
end

getgenv().AttackDelay = tonumber(getgenv().AttackDelay) or 0.1
getgenv().AutoAttack = false
getgenv().AutoAttackToken = 0
getgenv().CloneSoldierMode = getgenv().CloneSoldierMode or 'Random'
getgenv().LockedCloneOwnerUserId = nil
getgenv().LockedCloneTargetName = nil
getgenv().CYA_AntiAttack = getgenv().CYA_AntiAttack or false
getgenv().CYA_AntiAttackHooked = getgenv().CYA_AntiAttackHooked or false
refreshNPCAttackRemote()
ensureAntiAttackHook()

local areaList = getAreas()
local areaDropdown = Value:AddDropdown('CYA_AreaSelect', {
    Title = 'Select Target Area (Single)',
    Values = areaList,
    Default = 'All',
    Multi = false,
    Callback = function(V)
        getgenv().SetSelectedAreas(V)
    end
})

if areaDropdown and areaDropdown.OnChanged then
    pcall(function()
        areaDropdown:OnChanged(function(v)
            getgenv().SetSelectedAreas(v)
        end)
    end)
end

Value:AddDropdown('CYA_CloneSoldierMode', {
    Title = 'Clone Soldier Mode',
    Values = {'Random', 'Single Focus'},
    Default = 'Random',
    Multi = false,
    Callback = function(V)
        local chosen = V or 'Random'
        getgenv().CloneSoldierMode = chosen
        getgenv().LockedCloneOwnerUserId = nil
        getgenv().LockedCloneTargetName = nil
    end
})


Value:AddToggle('AutoAttackNPCs', {
    Title = 'Auto Attack NPCs',
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(V)
        getgenv().AutoAttackToken = (getgenv().AutoAttackToken or 0) + 1
        local token = getgenv().AutoAttackToken

        getgenv().AutoAttack = V
        if V then
            getgenv().CYA_AntiAttack = true
            refreshNPCAttackRemote()
            ensureAntiAttackHook()
            pcall(function()
                local antiOpt = Options and Options.CYA_AntiAttack
                if antiOpt and antiOpt.SetValue then
                    antiOpt:SetValue(true)
                end
            end)
            task.spawn(function()
                while getgenv().AutoAttack and getgenv().AutoAttackToken == token do
                    local selectedAreas = getSelectedAreasLive()

                    local runArea = workspace:FindFirstChild('RunArea')
                    local npcsFolder = runArea and runArea:FindFirstChild('RunAreaNPCs')
                    local foundTarget = false

                    if npcsFolder then
                        local lp = game.Players.LocalPlayer
                        local char = lp and lp.Character
                        local root = char and char:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
                        local pos = root and root.Position or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)

                        local combatEvents = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage'):FindFirstChild('shared/network/CombatNetwork@GlobalCombatEvents')
                        local attackRemote = combatEvents and combatEvents:FindFirstChild('Attack')
                        local cloneAttackRemote = combatEvents and combatEvents:FindFirstChild('CloneAttack')

                        if attackRemote then
                            for _, npc in ipairs(npcsFolder:GetChildren()) do
                                if not getgenv().AutoAttack or getgenv().AutoAttackToken ~= token then
                                    break
                                end

                                local npcName = npc and npc.Name
                                if npcName and matchesArea(npcName, selectedAreas) then
                                    foundTarget = true

                                    pcall(function()
                                        attackRemote:FireServer(1, npcName, pos)
                                    end)

                                    if cloneAttackRemote then
                                        local cloneTargetName, ownerUserId = getCloneAttackTarget()
                                        if cloneTargetName and ownerUserId then
                                            pcall(function()
                                                local runTag = 'run_' .. ownerUserId .. '_1_0'
                                                cloneAttackRemote:FireServer(cloneTargetName, runTag, 0, pos)
                                            end)
                                        end
                                    end

                                    break
                                end
                            end
                        end

                        if not foundTarget then
                            doNoTargetFallback(root, selectedAreas)
                        end
                    end

                    task.wait(getgenv().AttackDelay)
                end
            end)
        else
            getgenv().CYA_AntiAttack = false
            pcall(function()
                local antiOpt = Options and Options.CYA_AntiAttack
                if antiOpt and antiOpt.SetValue then
                    antiOpt:SetValue(false)
                end
            end)
        end
    end
})
Value:AddToggle('CYA_AntiAttack', {
    Title = 'Anti Attack',
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(V)
        getgenv().CYA_AntiAttack = V
        refreshNPCAttackRemote()
        ensureAntiAttackHook()
    end
})
